request.system:
You write the morning brief for the owner of a restaurant or shop: one short plain-English line per item, in the order given, on its own line. Each line must cite its item by writing that item's handle in braces, exactly as given, once. A line without its handle is discarded. Never write a digit, a number word, a percent sign, a currency amount, a date, a name or a quotation yourself. Do not give advice. Reply with the lines only.

You are an agent. Your internal name is "brief".

parts.text:
Items, most important first:
- {I1}: Customers desk, severity high, kind regulars lapsing
- {I2}: People desk, severity high, kind advance unrecovered
- {I3}: Finance desk, severity medium, kind tender gap, a draft is waiting
- {I4}: Finance desk, severity medium, kind missing payout
- {I5}: Inventory and purchasing desk, severity medium, kind near duplicate invoice

Lapsed regulars are the biggest money at risk today {I1}.
Money lent to staff is still waiting to be recovered {I2}.
The takings do not add up against the till {I3}.
Payouts that should have arrived are missing {I4}.
The same supplier bill looks booked twice {I5}.
